# Personalized Wood Name Puzzle, Acrylic Letters, Baby Shower Gift

[larkspursandbirch](https://www.etsy.com/shop/larkspursandbirch?ref=shop-header-name&listing_id=1145741800&from_page=listing)

[5 out of 5 stars](#reviews)

## Item highlights

- Materials: Wood, Acrylic, Floral
- Made to order

## Seller's description

This beautiful puzzle is the best personalized gift for any child or child to be in your life.  Name puzzles are both fun and educational and come in several design options to suit the child's interests or room decor.  This keepsake gift will promote name recognition and spelling as well as assist in the development of fine motor skills as the child ages. Perfect for any occasion!  Shower Gifts, Birth Gifts, Birthdays, Easter, and Christmas.

Made of high quality baltic birch, walnut or mahogany wood, printed masonite hardboard and cast acrylic. 

Puzzles are 4in tall with the length determined by the number of letters with a max of 19 inches.  The acrylic puzzle letters are approximately 3" high.  Puzzle pieces are dump and play. 

Wood Frame with Clear Acrylic Puzzle Pi
